record.title: Evaluate accession and admit specimen-derived guest validation
record.intent: Determine which specimen bytes match the corpus and what bounded guest work now matters.
requirements: Reconcile raw completeness and live-read differences separately from logical archive and APK integrity.
Use exact active Sparrow and Auklet hashes to decide whether existing harness evidence transfers or a bounded binary difference requires recovery.
Commit and push redacted conclusions; admit only justified disposable-guest successors, with physical entitlement and 1 GHz transitions reserved for later authorization gates.
acceptance: Accession quality and the next bounded guest validation are explicitly decided.

review.rationale: The upstream contract corrects an eMMC assumption to kernel-observed SD while retaining the verified source, size, read method and preservation requirements. The decision contract remains applicable; full-image boot must use this corrected storage evidence.

evidence.integrity: Two complete 31299993600-byte reads sealed; all bytes outside userdata equal; live-read differences preserved. docs/research/physical-specimen-raw-acquisition.md and experiments/physical-first-contact/specimen-raw-results.toml.
evidence.lineage: The storage-class correction does not change the exact active Sparrow/Auklet/Webcontrol matches to official .26. docs/research/physical-specimen-logical-acquisition.md.
evidence.continuation: Guest environment and ordinary installer recovery remain the next bounded scope. Physical packaging is unknown; no further physical access or mutation is needed to admit the guest batch.
